text: Exploratory Advising is for students who have either not decided on a major or those looking at a variety of major options. Our Mission. Our mission is to provide comprehensive and proactive academic advising to students who are exploring a variety of majors and careers. In cooperation with academic colleges and the Career Center, we will help students design a unique and meaningful college experience. Exploratory Advising What We Do. It is important to realize that discovering your major is a process. Our office is ready to assist you in actively exploring and identifying a variety of majors to match your personal as well as career goals. We will also help facilitate a smooth transition to the appropriate school advising office once you have decided on a major.

Academic advisor that works with Exploratory-Undeclared majors as well as any student seeking to explore their major options. Will assist students in developing a plan including both academic and extracurricular that will meet their personal, educational and career goals. Career Advising. In cooperation with the Career Center students have a designated career consultant that provides career counseling and testing. They will also help them match their interests and abilities with possible careers.

For continuing students who no longer wish to be in their current major, know which other major they want, but do not meet change of major requirements. Pre-major advising allows students to have a set advisor to assist in the registration process and ensure progress is aligned with change of major requirements. There is no GPA or academic standing requirement for pre-majors.
